title: On Organising the harvest for thirty acres
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：organise　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 organise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the shopkeeper ① organised the harvest for thirty acres year after year, and every buyer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the shopkeeper ② organises the harvest for thirty acres for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ organise the harvest for thirty acres at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ organised the harvest for thirty acres before — a line in the account for July 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Organising the harvest for thirty acres year after year, the shopkeeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ organise the papers into four bundles for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Organise the papers into four bundles at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the account, and a new buyer from the next shop ⑧ organises the papers into four bundles year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ organised the harvest for thirty acres again when nobody else would.

⑩ To organise the harvest for thirty acres, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody organises the harvest for thirty acres for the whole place again and somebody must organise the harvest for thirty acres year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 组织（一般过去式 organised the harvest for thirty acres：1976 年掌柜头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 组织（一般现在 organises the harvest for thirty acres：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 组织（不定式 to organise the harvest for thirty acres：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 组织（过去完成时 had organised the harvest for thirty acres：1970 年七月的账本上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 组织（动名词 organising the harvest for thirty acres 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 整理（organise the papers into four bundles：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去整理把文件整理成四捆）
G. v. 整理（organise the papers into four bundles：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 组织（后段两处：新来的买主照例 organises the papers into four bundles，而母亲又一次 organised the harvest for thirty acres）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1976 the shopkeeper organised the harvest for thirty acres year after year, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the shopkeeper organises the harvest for thirty acres for the whole place whenever the shop asks.
Organising the harvest for thirty acres year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
